 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the exam city details for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) Examination 2026 at the official website
 SSC releases SI CPO 2026 exam city details at ssc.gov.in; admit card to be released soon: Check direct link
 Princess Sonika New Delhi 4 min read Last Updated : Nov 16 2026 | 11:44 AM IST Listen to This Article
 The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the exam city details for the Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF) Examination 2026. Candidates for Paper 1 can now view their allotted examination city by visiting the official website at ssc.gov.in.    The SSC CPO Paper 1 examination will occur from November 23 to November 28, 2026. The commission will publish the admit cards around 2 to 3 days before each candidate's scheduled examination date.   The Staff Selection Commission has officially released the SSC CPO Exam City Intimation Slip 2026 for Paper 1 on its portal.  SSC CPO 2026: How to check exam city details?
 Candidates should follow the instructions provided in the examination notification while downloading their admission certificates.     1. Visit the official SSC website at ssc.gov.in. Also Read

   2. Open the designated login section for the SSC CPO 2026 examination.   3. Fill in the required login credentials.   4. Submit the details to view the examination city information.   5. Review the allotted examination city and save the details for future use. How to download SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 once released?
 Go to the official Staff Selection Commission website at ssc.gov.in.   Click the Login / Register button on the homepage (or navigate to the Admit Card section).   Choose the relevant regional SSC website or proceed directly through the unified candidate dashboard.   Find and click on the SSC CPO Paper 1 Admit Card 2026 (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2026) link.   Fill in your Registration Number and Password (or Date of Birth) along with the captcha code.   Click Submit / Login to access your admission certificate (admit card) status.   Your SSC CPO Admit Card 2026 will display on the screen.   Verify every detail carefully, download the PDF, and print a clear copy for examination day. Details mentioned on SSC CPO Hall Ticket 2026
 Candidate's Full Name   Roll Number   Registration Number   Date of Birth & Category   Candidate's Photo and Sign   Examination Name (Sub-Inspector in Delhi Police and CAPFs Examination 2026)   Exam Date, Shift and Timing   Reporting Time & Entry Closing Time   Exam Centre Name and Complete Address   Important Exam Day Instructions & Self-Declaration Form.    Documents needed alongside the SSC CPO Hall Ticket 2026   Printed Copy of SSC CPO Admit Card 2026   Valid Original Photo Identity Proof   Supporting Date of Birth Proof (if needed)   Recent Passport-Size Photographs   Additional Specific Documents like any extra declaration or scribe-related paperwork mentioned in your admit card instructions. SSC CPO 2026: Important notice for 21,000 candidates
 The commission has identified errors in the matriculation qualification information sent by approximately 21,000 candidates who applied for the SSC CPO 2026 examination. Although SSC has tentatively allowed these candidates to appear for the examination, they should upload a copy of their Class 10 marksheet through the candidate portal on the official website.    The candidates must finish the upload process by November 20, 2026. Failure to send the document by the last date may cause challenges during the result procedure phase. The respective SSC Regional Offices are also contacting the affected candidates via email regarding the errors.    Those who have received guidelines to submit their Class 10 marksheet must ensure they upload the document before the deadline.   ALSO READ:  SSC GD PET PST Admit Card 2026 Out: How to download the hall ticket? About the SSC CPO 2026
 SSC CPO Paper 1 Examination 2026 will be held in Computer-Based (CBT) Mode across multiple shifts from 23 November to 28 November 2026. Paper 1 is conducted for a duration of 2 hours (120 minutes) and comprises of 200 objective multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks across 4 sections: General Intelligence & Reasoning, General Knowledge & General Awareness, Quantitative Aptitude, and English Comprehension (with negative marking of 0.25 marks per wrong answer).   ALSO READ:  CBSE board exams 2027: Class 10, 12 datesheet released, check key dates   More From This Section
